violations.affected_code: GestureDetector(behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque, onTap: () => onSelected(entry.key), child: SizedBox(... Container(decoration: BoxDecoration(color: entry.value, ...))))
violations.explanation: Each swatch is a purely visual colored circle with no text or Semantics label. Screen reader users cannot tell which color a swatch represents, even though a name (entry.key) is available.

violations.type: Missing role / not exposed as button
violations.explanation: GestureDetector does not expose button semantics. Assistive technologies may not announce the swatches as actionable controls, and keyboard focus and activation are not supported. An InkWell, an IconButton, or Semantics(button: true) with focus handling would fix this.
The selected swatch is indicated only by a visual border. No Semantics(selected: true) or equivalent state is provided, so screen reader users cannot tell which color is currently selected.

violations.affected_code: border: Border.all(color: entry.key == selectedColor ? Colors.black : Colors.transparent, width: 3)
violations.explanation: The selection indicator is a black border. On dark swatches (e.g., black or navy) this border has little or no contrast, so the selected state may not be perceivable. No other indicator, such as a checkmark, is provided.
GestureDetector is not focusable and does not respond to keyboard activation. Users relying on a keyboard or switch access cannot select a color.
